summary.text: Brandon Whipple is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 83 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served in the Kansas House from 2013 to 2020 and as mayor of Wichita from 2020 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Brandon Whipple received an associate degree from Hesser College in New Hampshire and moved to Wichita, Kansas, after serving there with AmeriCorps.

He graduated from Wichita State University with a bachelor's degree in sociology and a master's degree in liberal studies, and received a doctorate in leadership studies from Franklin Pierce University.
His professional experience includes teaching as an adjunct professor at Wichita State University.
Whipple represented Kansas House District 96 from 2013 to 2020.
His committee assignments included serving as ranking minority member of the Information Technology Committee and the Higher Education Budget Committee.
He assumed office as mayor of Wichita on January 13, 2020, and left office on January 8, 2024, succeeding Jeff Longwell and followed by Lily Wu.
